description: This file defines a function for recording audit events into a database, with an environment check for enabling auditing. It exports the audit recording function for use in other parts of the project.

methods.name: recordAuditEvent({ userId, companyId, action, entity, entityId, details })
methods.description: Asynchronously records an audit event into the audit_trail table if auditing is enabled in the environment variables. It inserts details such as user ID, company ID, action, entity, entity ID, and additional details in JSON format.

ctags.signature: ({ userId, companyId, action, entity, entityId, details })
